title: Preparing a discussion room
topic: Two volunteers decide how to arrange a desk and two chairs for today's discussion.
levelRationale: Combine the purpose of facing one another with a changed location, rejecting an initially plausible brighter location. The potential-purpose clause, conditional location and reference across turns add N4 listening demands; numbered pictures are essential. These are original draft demands, not an official word-list or acoustic-level certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 質問と会話を聞いて、答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen to the question and conversation, then choose one answer.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 男の人は、机と椅子をどのように並べますか。
turns.translation: How will the man arrange the desk and chairs?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 今日の集まりも、二人とも窓のほうを向いて座るんですよね。
turns.translation: At today's gathering, both people will sit facing the window again, right?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 今日は話し合いをするので、向かい合って座れるようにしてください。
turns.translation: Today they will have a discussion, so please arrange things so they can sit facing each other.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: じゃあ、机は窓の近くに置きますか。そこのほうが明るいですし。
turns.translation: Then shall I put the desk near the window? It's brighter there, too.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 窓の近くだと、外の工事の音が聞こえるんです。今日は入口に近いほうへ動かしてもらえますか。
turns.translation: Near the window, you can hear the construction work outside. Could you move it closer to the entrance today?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 分かりました。椅子は、机をはさんで、一つずつですね。
turns.translation: Understood. One chair on each side, with the desk between them, right?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: はい、それでお願いします。
turns.translation: Yes, please arrange it that way.

options.label: 1の並べ方
options.rationale: The chairs face one another, but the desk remains near the window, where the construction noise is a problem.

options.label: 2の並べ方
options.rationale: The desk is near the entrance and the chairs face one another across it, satisfying both parts of the revised arrangement.

options.label: 3の並べ方
options.rationale: This keeps both the window-side location and the old side-by-side, window-facing seating.

options.label: 4の並べ方
options.rationale: The location is near the entrance, but both chairs still face the window from the same side of the desk.

explanation: The arrangement must satisfy two connected instructions: people need to sit facing each other for the discussion, and the desk must move toward the entrance because of noise near the window. The man's brighter-location proposal is not adopted. 机をはさんで、一つずつ confirms one chair on each side of the desk; it does not restore the old window-facing seating.

visual.description: Four equally presented numbered views of the same room, with a window on the far wall and an entrance on the near wall. Each view contains exactly one rectangular desk and two chairs. View 1: desk near the window, chairs facing each other across it. View 2: desk near the entrance, chairs facing each other across it. View 3: desk near the window, both chairs side by side on its near side, facing the window. View 4: desk near the entrance, both chairs side by side on its near side, facing the window. The entrance remains unobstructed in every view. No people, speech bubbles or highlighted arrangement.
